title: Count live quantum connections after destructive storage loss
statement: The completed report and rendered service proof give F_e(t)<=E min(1,2^(A(t)+b+w-K)) for K unknown logical qubits, live idle carriers A, other protected quantum memory b and at most w service-region qubits. Under the stated independent rate-gamma replacement erasures and at most c completions per Delta interval, a nonanticipating scheduler is dominated by B_(m+1)=Binomial(B_m,exp(-gamma Delta))+c, B0=N. Insufficient coherent service yields the stated strong-converse regime after initial live population decays.
